2610.08214.title: Mathematical Proof Assistants for Teaching Logic: The LogiKEy Methodology
2610.08214.paper_summary: We report on an approach to teaching logic to mixed groups of computer science, mathematics, and philosophy students, based on the logico-pluralistic LogiKEy methodology, used for more than a decade in courses, summer schools, and tutorials. LogiKEy uses classical higher-order logic (HOL) as a universal metalogic in which object logics, classical and non-classical alike, are encoded by defining their semantics; through these semantical embeddings a single proof assistant (e.g. Isabelle/HOL), with its automated theorem provers and (counter-)model finders, becomes one environment in which students learn, experiment with, and compare logics. After making the pedagogical case for proof assistants in the logic classroom, we present a graded sequence of classroom examples, each transition motivated by a limitation of the preceding representation, by a need for more explicit modelling resources, or by a new application. A liars-and-truth-tellers puzzle leads from propositional to modal logic; the Wise Men puzzle leads on to dynamic epistemic logic; Boolos's curious inference illustrates what a higher-order meta-logic buys, even for automated proof search; Chisholm's paradox takes the sequence into deontic logic, and from standard to dyadic deontic logic; and Gödel's ontological argument brings it to a research-level metaphysical argument. We then rebut the objection that embedding everything in classical HOL is monism rather than pluralism, reflect on three years of teaching such a course, and sketch the portability of the approach beyond Isabelle.
2610.08214.paper_summary_zh: 我們報告了一種教學邏輯的方法，針對混合的計算機科學、數學和哲學學生，基於邏輯多元主義的LogiKEy方法論，這種方法在課程、暑期學校和輔導中已使用超過十年。LogiKEy使用經典的高階邏輯（HOL）作為一種普遍的元邏輯，在其中對象邏輯，無論是經典的還是非經典的，都通過定義其語義來編碼；通過這些語義嵌入，單一的證明助手（例如Isabelle/HOL），連同其自動定理證明器和（反）模型尋找器，成為一個環境，在這個環境中，學生學習、實驗和比較邏輯。在為邏輯課堂中的證明助手提供教學案例後，我們展示了一系列分級的課堂範例，每個過渡都是由前一個表示的局限性、對更明確建模資源的需求或新的應用所驅動。一個說謊者和誠實者的謎題從命題邏輯引入到模態邏輯；智者謎題進一步引入動態認識論邏輯；Boolos的奇特推理說明了高階元邏輯所帶來的好處，即使對於自動證明搜索也是如此；Chisholm的悖論將序列帶入義務邏輯，並從標準的義務邏輯轉向雙重義務邏輯；而哥德爾的本體論論證則引入了一個研究級別的形而上學論證。我們隨後駁斥了將一切嵌入經典HOL是單一主義而非多元主義的反對意見，反思了三年的教學經驗，並勾勒出這種方法在Isabelle之外的可攜性。
